sets.name: OSD-476 shoot series — Apollo regolith plates

provenance.conditions: Apollo 11 / 12 / 17 regolith vs JSC-1A simulant, one plant of each per plate
provenance.description: 20 plate photographs across 5 imaging days. Every PlantCV shoot trait in this repository was scored from these images, and each plate ties to the RNA-seq samples grown on it.

reference.text: Paul, Elardo & Ferl (2022). Plants grown in Apollo lunar regolith present stress-associated transcriptomes that inform prospects for lunar exploration. Communications Biology 5:382.

sets.name: OSD-670 — crops in CI asteroid regolith simulant

provenance.conditions: CI asteroid regolith simulant blended with peat moss or perlite, 55 days after planting
provenance.description: Morphometric photographs of three crop species across simulant blends. Bundled because the OSDR file API is not readable from a browser on another origin.
provenance.organism: Raphanus sativus · Lactuca sativa · Capsicum annuum

reference.text: Russell, Fieber-Beyer & Yurkonis. CI Asteroid Regolith as an In Situ Plant Growth Medium for Space Crop Production. NASA OSDR OSD-670.
